policy: All tests run. The gate passes only when failures exactly match selector, count, and SHA-256. New failures and unexpectedly fixed exceptions both fail the gate.

extension.reason: Tests a removed CacheService data model end-to-end: legacy 'scanCache' storage key + fixed 24h timestamp expiry + callback-style chrome.storage.local.get + a remove() method, versus the current domain-keyed in-memory Map with per-entry TTL, 'urlCache' persist key, synchronous get()/set(), debounced persist, and delete() (see services/CacheService.js). Not a mock-signature tweak; needs a full rewrite against the current cache model. Renewed 2026-09-08 (ASPS-753 hybrid baseline fix); tracked for a follow-up rewrite.
